purpose: Show how a business decision changes when costs, demand and other assumptions change.

story.origin_narrative: Brand positioning story, not a claim about company founding history. A forecast can look authoritative until one number moves. The Scenario Room pulls the hidden levers into view so a team can reason in ranges, not illusions.
story.core_belief: The assumptions are part of the answer.

signature_phrase: Change the assumptions. See what changes.

personality.tone: analytical, calm, precise; numbers with interpretation, never certainty theater
principles: Scenarios are not forecasts of guaranteed outcomes

design_system.typography: serif decision headlines paired with mono-spaced scenario labels
design_system.motif: scenario matrix, branching lines and balanced ledger rules

relationship.parent_visibility: Small endorsement after the individual product story; never replace product identity
relationship.payment: Original exact-price Systemia Stripe checkout only; no rebranding of Stripe product without separate approval

governance.visual_identity_direction: Custom CSS motif; not a registered logo or legal mark

assets.usage: Emblem and palette are original working design directions. Not trademark cleared and not proof of external publication.
